name: network-admin
title: Network administrator
description: A device inventory, an IP/VLAN map and a network change log (pair with operations for the runbook and incident log).
audience: Concrete and operational: name the device, VLAN or link and the exact change; give commands and addresses; flag outage risk and the rollback first.

farm_tasks.title: Config change summary
farm_tasks.does: Summarises a device config change: what was added, removed or changed, in plain words.
farm_tasks.escalate: Claude checks the summary against the diff before approval; a routing or firewall-rule change comes to you.

farm_tasks.title: IP and VLAN lookup
farm_tasks.does: Quotes, word for word, the lines of the IP/VLAN map that answer a question such as which VLAN holds a subnet.
farm_tasks.escalate: Claude reads the map itself when the engine returns no quote, or a quote that does not answer the question.

farm_tasks.title: Link and firewall log triage
farm_tasks.does: Groups link-flap or firewall log lines into distinct problems, with the lines that show each.
farm_tasks.escalate: Claude reads the raw log for any outage, and before a rule is changed.

farm_tasks.title: Change record draft
farm_tasks.does: Drafts the network change record from the config summary: what, why, window, rollback.
farm_tasks.escalate: You check the window and the rollback; Claude steps in if either is missing from the source.

files.content:
# {TITLE} device inventory

<!-- Every device: name, model, location, management address, owner. Never write a credential here. -->

| Device | Model | Location | Mgmt address | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|

# {TITLE} IP and VLAN map

<!-- Subnets, VLANs and what lives on them. -->

| Subnet / VLAN | Purpose | Gateway | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|

# {TITLE} network change log

<!-- Firewall, DNS, routing and certificate changes: when, what, window, rollback. -->

| Date | Change | Device | Window | Rollback |
|---|---|---|---|---|
